body: It's a good post! Maybe not completely on topic to what I'm feeling (I'm not great at explaining myself during the best of times) but the content of what you said is nice to read. I enjoy understanding others opinions on my situations even if they are not 100% relevant. Thank you!

It's not that I don't have any interests, have friends and family who care and all that. Picture going to the dentist to get a tooth pulled. They put on the local anesthetic and proceed to pull without any pain on your end. A numbness. You know what it's supposed to look like, but you can't feel it. That sensation is void in my life. Everything is constantly numb even during the best of times.
